LEGAL.LABEL: Legal information
LEGAL.INTRO: Read the terms and information about privacy and storage at {{ hotelName }}.
LEGAL.DRAFT_NOTICE: This content is not a final legal document or legal advice. Before publication, the hotel operator must complete the indicated details, verify actual practices and obtain a review appropriate to their jurisdiction.

OPERATOR.TITLE: Operator and scope
OPERATOR.BODY: These terms are a proposal for using {{ hotelName }}. To complete: the operator's legal name, address, country, contact details and effective date. Adapt them to applicable law and the features actually available.

ACCOUNT.TITLE: Account and access
ACCOUNT.BODY: Use accurate details and protect your credentials. Do not share passwords or access other people's accounts. To define: minimum age, any guardian consent requirements and the account recovery or closure procedure.

CONDUCT.TITLE: Conduct and content
CONDUCT.BODY: Respect other users. Do not publish threats, harassment, unlawful content or other people's personal information. Do not use the service for fraud or unauthorized access. To complete: community rules, reporting channels and handling of user-generated content.

PURCHASES.TITLE: Purchases and virtual goods
PURCHASES.BODY: Review the price, currency and description before purchasing. To complete: seller identity, taxes, delivery, withdrawal rights, refunds and support. Mandatory consumer rights cannot be excluded through this template.

MODERATION.TITLE: Moderation and availability
MODERATION.BODY: {{ hotelName }} may require maintenance and moderation measures. To define: reasons and duration of restrictions, notices, appeals and support contacts. This template does not establish an availability guarantee or waive statutory rights.

CHANGES.TITLE: Changes and enquiries
CHANGES.BODY: To define: how changes will be communicated, when they take effect and how to contact the operator. Retain the current version and explain the conditions before requesting acceptance.

CONTROLLER.TITLE: Data controller
CONTROLLER.BODY: To complete: identity and contact details of the controller for {{ hotelName }}, address, jurisdiction and privacy contact. This template does not yet identify a legal controller.

DATA.TITLE: Data used
DATA.BODY: The interface requests email and password for registration and credentials for sign-in. It displays account and avatar data and stores session information in the browser. To inventory: data received by the backend, IP addresses, logs, messages and purchase data.

PURPOSES.TITLE: Purposes and legal bases
PURPOSES.BODY: Visible features include account access, preferences, the hotel client and purchase coordination. The operator must document the purposes and legal bases of each actual processing activity. This page does not assume consent is appropriate for every activity.

PROVIDERS.TITLE: External services and recipients
PROVIDERS.BODY: The app loads Ubuntu from Google Fonts, avatar images from the configured service, and may load PayPal when opening a purchase and Nitro when entering the hotel. To verify: active providers, shared data, agreements, locations and safeguards for international transfers.

RETENTION.TITLE: Retention and security
RETENTION.BODY: To establish: retention periods, account deletion, backups and backend security measures. Signing out removes local account and token data on this device; it does not demonstrate deletion of server data.

RIGHTS.TITLE: Rights and contact
RIGHTS.BODY: Available rights depend on applicable law. To complete: contact and procedure for access, correction, deletion and other requests, identity verification, deadlines and the relevant authority. This template does not yet offer an operational contact channel.

SCOPE.TITLE: Cookies and local storage
SCOPE.BODY: Cookies and localStorage are different technologies. This interface uses localStorage for sessions and preferences; this review does not establish the absence of server, Nitro or third-party cookies. The operator must audit the deployed site.

STORAGE.TITLE: Interface storage
STORAGE.BODY: xdr-token and xdr-refresh-token store the website access and refresh tokens; xdr-account stores account/avatar data. xdr-lang stores language and xdr-theme the theme. localStorage has no configured automatic expiry. Sign-out removes the tokens and account; language and theme remain until cleared or changed.

THIRD_PARTIES.TITLE: External service cookies
THIRD_PARTIES.BODY: PayPal, Nitro, image and font services or other deployment services may have their own practices. To inventory: name, provider, purpose, category and duration of each active cookie or technology. This page does not claim all are necessary or that a consent system already exists.

CHOICES.TITLE: Browser choices and consent
CHOICES.BODY: You can clear cookies and storage in browser settings; this may sign you out and reset preferences. The operator must implement consent and withdrawal controls where required and avoid loading non-essential technologies before appropriate authorization. This page does not install or replace those controls.

CONTACT.TITLE: Updates and contact
CONTACT.BODY: To complete: operator contact, review date and a verified inventory of the {{ hotelName }} deployment. Review this policy when adding analytics, advertising or new providers.
